LanguageData.LP_AbyssExile.label: deep sea exile
LanguageData.LP_AbyssExile.description:
A storm giant exiled from the deep sea court drifted onto this strange coast in a thunderstorm, with two human sailors who refused to leave him.

The storm giant is empty-handed; the first day of the start is a thunderstorm that followed them in from the sea.

A coastal map is recommended: storm giants walk through shallow ocean and marsh as if on flat ground, are stronger in wind and rain, and can foresee big raids; but they have few children, and are gloomy all day long.

LanguageData.LP_AbyssExile.scenario.parts.GameStartDi:
The gates of the deep sea court closed behind you.

Two sailors rowed a battered boat after you for three days and nights, until a final wave slammed you all onto this strange coast. The thunderstorm hasn't stopped; it came with you.

You can see the shadows of the future, but not your own. Survive here first.
